mapper.sql: id, order_id, user_id, status, postal_code, city, state, country, shipping_minor, currency, promised_from, promised_to, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipments (id, order_id, user_id, status, postal_code, city, state, country, shipping_minor, currency, promised_from, promised_to, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{postalCode}, #{city}, #{state}, #{country}, #{shippingMinor}, #{currency}, #{promisedFrom}, #{promisedTo}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE shipments SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (id, aggregate_id, event_id, event_type, partition_key, payload, occurred_at, published_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{partitionKey}, #{payload}::jsonb, #{occurredAt}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_id, event_id, event_type, partition_key, payload::text AS payload, occurred_at, published_at FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY occurred_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET published_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM inbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbox (event_id, event_type) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
